answer: Think of each newcomer as stranded on a probation island: its work counts for nothing until K established agents countersign it, each anchoring a bond drawn from a different voucher lineage. A sybil cluster can only countersign itself, so its islands stay dark and weightless; graduation needs backers whose histories never converge. Anyone may whisper a duplicate-behaviour claim, staking a deposit: a proven claim slashes the fake's anchor and pays the whisperer, a false one burns the deposit. Attacker cost is K independent reputations per identity, never a signup fee.
